assignments.title: Lab 12 — Gun Violence Dashboards in Tableau Public and Gemini Canvas

rubrics.title: Lab 12 — Gun Violence Dashboards in Tableau Public and Gemini Canvas

criteria.description: Tableau Public Data Source: correct five-field GVA working CSV; source and data period recorded; incident ID/date/state/victim fields validated; separately published source and working access link.

Tableau Public dashboard: proportional-symbol state map, grouped victim killed/injured bars, daily incident bars; correct COUNTD/SUM, GVA citation and dates, clear five-second design, map filters and reset.

Gemini Canvas dashboard: uses the same CSV, shows the same three views with correct values and dates; state selection/reset, one verified design improvement, and a working shared app with default data.

Canvas text entry: two functioning dashboard URLs, exact Tableau Public data source name, four to six comparison sentences, two checked values, download date/period, design critique and verified AI improvement.
